_comment: Rename to epoch_open.json and put it beside EpochTake3.exe. You do not need to edit this by hand: use 'Change plate...' in the program.
_language_comment: Interface language: "en" or "es". English is the default, so a lab that works in Spanish sets this once, here or in Preferences. Both programs share it, and so does the spreadsheet they write. A one-off override without editing anything: run with --lang es.
_blank_comment: How the blanking verdict is judged. blank_cv_limit_percent is Gen5's own rule and its default: the highest CV% across the wavelengths read, on raw absorbances. The two _au limits are ours -- spread is an absolute floor under the CV% check, and divergence only decides which well is painted red, not whether the blank passes. See docs/GEN5_NOTES.md.
